hero.title: Japan Travel Safety Kit
hero.subtitle: Everything you need for a safer trip to Japan.
hero.intro: Three things to sort out before you fly: a way to receive official warnings, a data connection so they reach you, and insurance for when plans change. Nothing here is a hotel or a tour.

cards.title: Japan Disaster Guide
cards.why: When a warning goes out in Japan, it goes out in Japanese. The app carries Japan Meteorological Agency warnings in 7 languages, after JMA confirms them.
facts: Earthquake, tsunami, typhoon and heavy-rain warnings, sent after JMA confirms them
115,000+ evacuation shelters on a map, searchable from where you are
Free. One optional one-time unlock (¥300 / $1.99) for sharing your safety status with family

options.name: Japan Disaster Guide
options.note: iPhone. Not available in every country yet.

cards.title: Get data before you land
cards.why: Warnings arrive as push notifications. They only reach you if your phone has data when they are sent. A travel eSIM installed before departure means you are connected from the moment you land.
facts: Your phone must be eSIM-compatible and not locked to a carrier. Check the vendor's compatibility list first
Install while you still have a stable connection at home. Activation happens in Japan

options.name: Airalo
facts: Data-only eSIM for Japan (no phone number)
Runs on the SoftBank network, plus one other, per Airalo
Can be installed in advance from outside Japan
options._source: https://www.airalo.com/japan-esim (read 2026-09-03). Prices are not shown on purpose; they change.

options.name: Saily
options._source: https://saily.com/esim-japan/ returned 403 on 2026-09-03. Fill facts from the page by hand before enabling.

cards.title: Cover the trip that changes
cards.why: A typhoon can ground flights for a day. An earthquake can close a rail line. Short-term visitors are not enrolled in Japan's national health insurance, so hospital bills are paid in full. Insurance is the part of the kit that pays when plans change.
facts: Read what is covered and the limits before you buy. Cover differs by plan and by your home country

options.name: SafetyWing Nomad Insurance
facts: Travel medical insurance: medical treatment and hospitalization, evacuation to a better-equipped hospital, lost checked luggage and travel delay, each with limits
Can be bought before you depart or after you have already left
Priced per 4 weeks. The price depends on age
options._source: https://safetywing.com/nomad-insurance (read 2026-09-03). Confirm Japan is covered for the buyer's home country before enabling.
